<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="shade" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity=".48"/>
      <stop offset=".55" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity=".34"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity=".72"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="brand" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="6" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".35"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <!-- darkened photo-style background -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#7D8490"/>
  <rect x="0" y="138" width="390" height="270" fill="#939393"/>
  <circle cx="313" cy="184" r="45" fill="#D0CECD" opacity=".72"/>
  <polygon points="0,412 82,306 153,392 224,274 390,420 390,560 0,560" fill="#4A4A4A"/>
  <polygon points="0,461 106,365 190,451 274,352 390,465 390,610 0,610" fill="#939393" opacity=".7"/>
  <rect x="36" y="289" width="70" height="123" fill="#4A4A4A" opacity=".72"/>
  <polygon points="48,289 71,265 94,289" fill="#4A4A4A" opacity=".72"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="url(#shade)"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <text x="22" y="27" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
  <line x1="322" y1="21" x2="326" y2="21" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="322" y1="25" x2="326" y2="25" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="322" y1="29" x2="326" y2="29" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="330" y1="29" x2="330" y2="17" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="335" y1="29" x2="335" y2="14" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="340" y1="29" x2="340" y2="11" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="353" cy="22" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <line x1="350" y1="27" x2="356" y2="27" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="365" y="15" width="22" height="13" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="367" y="17" width="15" height="9" rx="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="388" y="19" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- branding -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <polygon points="194,68 181,91 186,91 177,108 204,84 198,84 207,68" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="214" y="101" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="34" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">tinder</text>
  </g>
  <text x="195" y="144" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="medium" fill="#FFFFFF">Meet people who spark your interest.</text>
  <text x="195" y="167" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="normal" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".9">Connect with someone new today.</text>

  <!-- primary actions -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="75" y="405" width="240" height="44" rx="62" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="195" y="433" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">CREATE ACCOUNT</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="75" y="459" width="240" height="44" rx="62" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="195" y="487" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">SIGN IN</text>
  </g>

  <!-- social sign-in buttons -->
  <g>
    <rect x="75" y="514" width="240" height="40" rx="62" fill="#000000" fill-opacity=".22" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <circle cx="101" cy="534" r="9" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="101" y="539" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#000000">●</text>
    <text x="195" y="539" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="medium" fill="#FFFFFF">SIGN IN WITH APPLE</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="75" y="560" width="240" height="40" rx="62" fill="#000000" fill-opacity=".22" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <circle cx="101" cy="580" r="9" fill="#4396F7"/>
    <text x="101" y="585" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">f</text>
    <text x="195" y="585" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="medium" fill="#FFFFFF">SIGN IN WITH FACEBOOK</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="75" y="606" width="240" height="40" rx="62" fill="#000000" fill-opacity=".22" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <circle cx="101" cy="626" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="101" y1="626" x2="101" y2="620" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="101" y1="626" x2="105" y2="629" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="195" y="631" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="medium" fill="#FFFFFF">SIGN IN WITH PHONE NUMBER</text>
  </g>

  <!-- consent -->
  <text x="195" y="676" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="normal" fill="#FFFFFF">By tapping Create Account, you agree to our</text>
  <text x="195" y="691" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">Terms of Service</text>
  <line x1="151" y1="694" x2="239" y2="694" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="195" y="710" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="normal" fill="#FFFFFF">and acknowledge our Privacy Policy.</text>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="744" width="390" height="100" fill="#000000" fill-opacity=".42"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="744" x2="390" y2="744" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".18"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,775 51,765 63,775 63,790 55,790 55,781 47,781 47,790 39,790" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="51" y="809" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#FFFFFF">HOME</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="130" cy="773" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="130,765 130,781 124,775 130,781 136,775" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="130" y="809" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#FFFFFF">DISCOVER</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="185" y="766" width="20" height="14" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="190,780 188,785 195,780" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="191" cy="773" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="199" cy="773" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="195" y="809" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#FFFFFF">CHATS</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="286" cy="772" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="286" cy="769" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <ellipse cx="286" cy="778" rx="6" ry="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="286" y="809" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#FFFFFF">PROFILE</text>
  </g>
  <rect x="168" y="832" width="54" height="4" rx="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
</svg>
